children: Sen. Ron Wyden, the incoming Democratic chairman of the Senate Finance Committee, said three major banks linked to Jeffrey Epstein will be the committee’s top investigation targets after Democrats take control next year. According to Sina Finance, Wyden said Monday at the Capitol that the banks could have stopped Epstein’s crimes if they had done nothing beyond complying with the law over the years. Wyden did not name the banks in his Monday remarks, but a report he previously issued identified Bank of America Corp., JPMorgan Chase & Co., and Deutsche Bank AG as having facilitated Epstein’s illegal activities. Epstein died in a New York jail cell in 2019 after being arrested on sex-trafficking charges.

title: Ron Wyden Says Three Epstein-Linked Banks Will Top Senate Finance Committee Probe
